title: The Rams: the shore and the offering
part: Energy re-shoots (odyssey/writers-room/BIBLE.md section 6): a still ending

result: Kept, for the ending only. The film now ends on the offering: Odysseus at the fire with his arms raised to Zeus, the crew either side, from 63.7 s to the end (motion 0.15 -> 3.75, still 0.96 -> 0.27); the last two seconds settle into his held pose (the SACRIFICE ends at 68.9 s), an ending held on a figure, not an empty shore. Not done: shot 14, 'drive the flock to the ship, and row away' (motion 0.32): planned as an ACTION wide on the men driving, the only legal camera was out on the water and the flock a few pixels, so it was left as take 2 has it; nobody rows in the scene's performance (that would be a performance variable).
